title: Slide Render Model
description: Per-slide controlled layout / render model. The intermediate artifact between a slide_plan and the two downstream consumers: the SVG preview renderer (scripts/generate_svg_previews.py, today supporting kinds text / line / shape / image_slot / kpi across every layout the render-model generator currently emits — cover, section_divider, executive_summary, key_message, two_column, kpi_dashboard, timeline, conclusion) and the expanded native editable PPTX exporter (scripts/export_pptx.py, today covering layouts cover, kpi_dashboard, agenda, section_divider, executive_summary, key_message, two_column, timeline, conclusion with the same text / line / shape / image_slot / kpi primitive set; comparison_table and the table / chart_placeholder primitives remain fail-closed). Only owned primitives are allowed: text, shape, line, image_slot, table, kpi, chart_placeholder. This schema is deliberately NOT an arbitrary-SVG-to-PPTX contract: no SVG-specific keys (transform, viewBox, href, xlink:href, filter, foreignObject, ...) are accepted. Bounds are required for every primitive. Style references must be token refs into the design_system, not raw values. Image references are by image_manifest id, not by URL or path. Content must be synthetic and source-traceable; raw sensitive source text does not belong here.

index.description: 1-based slide index. Validators cross-check this against the matching deck_plan.slides[].index and slide_plans/<file>.index.

layout.description: Layout id this render model targets. Validators cross-check this against the matching deck_plan.slides[].layout and a layout name in the chosen template.

canvas.description: Pixel canvas the primitives live on. Validators cross-check this against design_system.grid.width_px / height_px when the design_system is available.

source_refs.description: Required and non-empty. Opaque source identifiers this slide draws from. Validators require every value to be declared in deck_brief.source_refs, and fail closed (not silently skip) if the deck_brief is missing, malformed, or has no source_refs of its own. Keeps render models source-traceable without putting raw source text on disk.

primitives.description: Ordered list of controlled primitives. The only kinds accepted are text, shape, line, image_slot, table, kpi, chart_placeholder. No SVG-specific kinds, no arbitrary HTML/foreignObject. Primitive ids are unique within the slide. The kind-specific payload field (text / shape / line / image_slot / table / kpi / chart_placeholder) must match 'kind' exactly; the runtime validator enforces that.

id.description: Stable id, unique within this slide's render model.

slot_id.description: Optional reference to a layout slot id. When set, validators cross-check that the named slot exists on the chosen layout and (if the layout slot declares primitive_kind) that this primitive's kind matches that mapping.

kind.description: The controlled primitive kind. New kinds may not be added without a schema bump and matching validator support.

bounds.description: Axis-aligned bounding box in canvas pixels. Validators enforce x+w <= canvas.width_px and y+h <= canvas.height_px.

style.description: Token references into the design_system. Raw color / font values are not permitted here; the renderer resolves tokens at render time.

color_token.description: Reference into design_system.palette used as text or stroke color.

typography_token.description: Reference into design_system.typography. The two roles supported today are heading and body.

text.description: Payload for kind=text. content is the literal display string; role is the typographic role.

shape.description: Payload for kind=shape. Only closed shapes that map natively to PPTX are accepted.

line.description: Payload for kind=line. The line is drawn corner-to-corner inside bounds (top-left to bottom-right). For a horizontal divider give bounds.h=1; for a vertical divider give bounds.w=1.

image_slot.description: Payload for kind=image_slot. image_ref names an image_manifest entry id; the slot is rendered as the referenced image at this primitive's bounds. URLs, file:// paths, and absolute paths are NOT permitted here — the pattern below restricts image_ref to a manifest id.

image_ref.description: Manifest entry id; validators cross-check this is declared in image_manifest.images[].id.

table.description: Payload for kind=table. Header columns plus rows of string cells. Renders as a native PPTX table.

kpi.description: Payload for kind=kpi. A single labeled value with optional delta string. Content is treated as a display string; no numeric arithmetic happens here.

chart_placeholder.description: Payload for kind=chart_placeholder. Reserves the bounds for a chart that the renderer does not yet implement. Carries the intended chart_kind and a synthetic caption so the slot is inspectable in previews. Charting is TODO.
